interactive.$description: Interactive-state colors. The `background.*` set is the single source of truth for hover / pressed / selected backgrounds across every interactive component. Replaces the dozens of raw `--scout-color-cool-gray-100` / `cool-gray-200` / `blue-50` / `blue-700` / `red-700` references that used to live in component CSS.

hover.$description: Default hover background for buttons, list items, dropdown options.

selected.$description: Resting selected background (segmented control track, sidebar selected row).

brand-hover.$description: Hover for brand-tinted neutral surfaces (anchor-links rest hover, sidebar nav rest hover).

brand-strong.$description: Filled brand surface — primary button rest.

critical-strong.$description: Filled critical surface — critical button rest.
